products.name: SyncVerse
products.subtitle: Manage planning, development, review, and approval in one workspace
products.summary: Consolidate tasks scattered across messengers, documents, and separate deployment tools in SyncVerse, ensuring critical changes go live only after accountable human review.
vsLegacyPoints: Requirements, system changes, test results, and approval records are scattered across separate tools, obscuring overall progress.
When an issue occurs after a change goes live, tracing who changed what and rolling back takes significant time.
Teams must sign in separately to admin consoles, websites, and testing tools to coordinate releases.
vsAgentPoints: Track requirements, task execution, quality verification, and approval history sequentially in one workspace.
Reviewers compare before/after diffs before approving critical changes and can restore previous versions whenever needed.
Connect other Empasy modules as needed to unify cross-department workflows in a single console.

faqs.question: Can we adopt SyncVerse standalone without other Empasy products?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can adopt SyncVerse alone for work intake and staged approval governance, then connect modules like SyncETA or SyncBoot whenever needed.

faqs.question: Are critical system changes applied automatically without human review?
faqs.answer: No. Production releases and sensitive structural changes require explicit review and approval from authorized reviewers, and can be halted immediately if any anomaly is found.

faqs.question: Can SyncVerse run in air-gapped or private enterprise networks?
faqs.answer: Yes. Alongside cloud deployment, SyncVerse supports on-premises installation directly on your internal servers.

products.summary: Verify hundreds of regional and product pages using representative and sample URLs, record only verified items as passed, and honestly flag uncertain screens as [Needs Review] with screenshots.
coreCapabilities: Browser Action Recorder (Security Keypad & Cookie Banner Bypass)
Excel / One-Line Prompt Conversion & Multi-Account Testing
Full Link & Layout Overlap Audit + Bug Kanban One-Click Recheck
vsLegacyPoints: Time limits force teams to manually check only one or two of hundreds of regional/product pages, while minor layout changes break scripts.
Virtual security keypads and global cookie popups halt automation, leaving subtle text overlaps and broken 404 links to manual eye checks.
Unchecked areas risk slipping through as passed, and every bug requires manual spreadsheet screenshots and full re-clicks after fixes.
vsAgentPoints: Cover multi-region/product pages via representative & sample URLs using recording, Excel, or one-line prompts with automatic UI relocation.
Bypass virtual keypads and cookie banners automatically, and audit every sub-link (404) and layout overlap without pre-written scripts.
Count only verified checks as passed, flag uncertain screens as [Needs Review], and re-verify photo Kanban tickets with one click on [Check Now].

richFeatures.title: Browser Action Recorder
richFeatures.description: Record clicks, inputs, and scrolls into reusable action blocks while automatically handling security virtual keypads, global cookie consent banners, and personal data masking.

richFeatures.title: Excel & One-Line Prompt Test Conversion
richFeatures.description: Upload existing Excel/CSV test sheets or type a single sentence to generate checks, backed by representative/sample URL targeting and pre-run validation.

richFeatures.title: Multi-Account Simultaneous Testing
richFeatures.description: Open two isolated browser sessions side by side (such as customer and admin) to verify real-time cross-role workflows and separate per-role logs.

richFeatures.title: Full Link & Visual Defect Audit
richFeatures.description: Without pre-built scenarios, crawl sub-links via a site knowledge graph to catch 404 errors, destination mismatches, text overlaps, empty regions, and broken media playback.

richFeatures.title: Bug Kanban Board & [Check Now] Recheck
richFeatures.description: Auto-create tickets with defect captures across Backlog, Open, Resolved, and Closed stages, block duplicate tickets, remember [Not a Bug] decisions, and re-verify in one click.

richFeatures.title: Honest [Needs Review] Triage & Scheduled Audits
richFeatures.description: Count only verified checks as passed, separate uncertain screens with screenshots, and connect scheduled runs with Jira, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Slack.

processSteps.title: Phase 1 · Prepare Check Scenarios
processSteps.description: Record browser actions or convert existing Excel sheets and one-line prompts, then pre-validate against sample URLs to prevent brittle tests.

processSteps.title: Phase 2 · Auto-Execute & Classify Screens
processSteps.description: Launch real browsers to audit sub-links and layout overlaps, relocate shifted buttons automatically, and classify results into Pass, Defect, or [Needs Review].

processSteps.title: Phase 3 · Track Defects & One-Click Recheck

faqs.question: Can non-developer QA staff or service operators use SyncETA immediately?
faqs.answer: Yes. Anyone can record everyday browser clicks, upload existing Excel/CSV test sheets, or run one-line prompts like checking sub-links and layout overlaps without writing test code.

faqs.question: Does it keep working when virtual security keypads or global cookie banners appear?
faqs.answer: Yes. SyncETA recognizes financial virtual security keypads, automatically closes global cookie consent popups, and masks sensitive personal information in recordings and captures.

faqs.question: How can we verify actual ROI without relying on exaggerated claims?
faqs.answer: Multi-page sampling, scenario-free link and overlap audits, keypad/cookie handling, photo-attached Kanban tickets, and one-click [Check Now] re-verification are guaranteed from day one. Time savings and pre-release defect counts are measured directly during a 2–4 week pilot on one live site.

faqs.question: Can we apply SyncETA to live websites and closed intranet systems?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can test existing websites without modifying application code, and run locally via the desktop app or on-premise server for VPN and air-gapped intranet systems.

faqs.question: Does SyncETA integrate with Jira, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Slack?
faqs.answer: Yes. Alongside its built-in Bug Kanban board, SyncETA connects with Jira issue tracking, Jenkins and GitHub Actions deployment pipelines, and Slack or email alerts.
